notes.title: [UPDATE] Lunar Bugs Sent to Space Hell.
notes.content: [p]Moon explorers, we’ve mopped up some lunar bugs that were lurking in the shadows of the demo. Turns out the Moon is not only lifeless… it’s also [i]bug-infested[/i]. The Update is live as of NOW. Here’s what we fixed before the infestation spread:[/p][h3]🔧 Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p][b]Ping Hell:[/b] Fixed a bug where, if your ping was higher than Neil Armstrong’s cholesterol, you couldn’t travel to the next level. Now you can lag your way to the stars.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Anarchy:[/b] In splitscreen co-op, both controllers were being assigned to Player 2, leaving Player 1 useless. We’ve convinced the controllers to share custody.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Airlock Prison:[/b] Fixed an issue where one unlucky astronaut could get permanently trapped in the airlock before stepping onto the lunar surface. Now you can both enjoy suffocating in freedom.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pause Button Crisis:[/b] The Client (in some setups) couldn’t open the pause menu. We decided everyone deserves to stop and cry mid-game, so now it works.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Discord Overlay Battle:[/b] Joining a match invitation no longer overlaps with Discord’s in-game text. Less UI warfare on your screen.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧪 Minigame Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Slime Massacre Rebalanced:[/b] You now get more time per slime kill and a bigger starting timer. Time to farm that lunar goo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slime Gun Buff:[/b] Increased weapon spread so hitting slimes is easier. Basically, we gave you a cosmic shotgun. Don’t thank us, thank the slimes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s all for this patch. If you want to keep up with every bug we brutally execute on the Moon or find friendly Astronauts to explore, join our [b]Discord[/b]:[/p][p]👉 [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2khQag6BWn"]https://discord.gg/2khQag6BWn[/url][/p][p][/p]
